title: 荷捌き口用ドックシェルター
description: 倉庫の荷捌き開口に取り付ける三辺型ドックシェルター。プリーツ状の側面生地、厚みのある側幕と上幕、誘導帯、補強縁、前後フレーム、壁付け金具、斜材、傾斜ひさしと開口した雨樋を造形。トラック、倉庫壁、シャッター、ドック床や荷役機械は含みません。幕は固定メッシュで、変形・衝突・水密性・耐候性・安全性の検証や実装はありません。底面中央原点は施工の壁面基準や取付高さではなく、配置時に壁面位置と高さを合わせてください。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）3.302 × 3.505 × 1.028 m、21,104三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: Three-sided warehouse loading-bay curtain shelter with pleated side fabric, thick side and head curtains, alignment strips, reinforced hems, front and rear frames, wall brackets, diagonal stays, sloped canopy and genuinely open gutter. No truck, warehouse wall, shutter, dock floor or loading equipment is included. Curtains are fixed meshes with no deformation or collision behavior, and no weather-sealing, structural or safety validation. The bottom-centered placement origin is not a wall-mount or installation-height datum; align the mounting plane and height in the target scene. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 3.302 × 3.505 × 1.028 m; 21,104 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
